The ipNX opportunity

A premium fibre base, growing into new cities.

Why it matters in Nigeria

The phone is now the wallet. Fraud has followed it.

In Nigeria, money, identity and work have moved onto the phone and the home connection. The attacks that follow are phishing links, fake banking pages, social engineering and infected devices. They hit the customer first, and the internet provider second, through support calls and lost trust. Lagos, where ipNX built its network, carries most of the fraud.

Consumer FTTH

Fibre households: the strongest fit for protection.

A fibre home is not one device. It is the parents' phones that carry the banking apps, the children's tablet, and the laptop used for school or remote work. ipNX fibre customers already pay a monthly bill, sit on plans of up to 1 Gbps, and expect their provider to keep the connection safe. That is why we recommend fibre homes as the launch segment.

What the household gets

A fibre ladder ipNX can sell from day one

What it does for ipNX

SMEs & ipNX Business

SMEs: protection sized for a shop, a clinic or a school office.

Small businesses in Lagos and Abuja run on anything from two to forty devices: the owner's phone with the banking app, one or two PCs holding the accounts and customer records, and staff phones on WhatsApp. They face the same phishing and ransomware as large companies, with no IT department. ipNX already sells them connectivity and is densifying its network in SME clusters. Protection makes ipNX their technology partner, not just their line.

    Basic or Advanced: what each customer actually gets.

    A DSG division · Personal Cyber Warranty

    Bitdefender stops the attack. eInsurer covers what still gets through.

    No security product stops every attack. eInsurer, DSG's personal cyber division, adds a Personal Cyber Warranty that reimburses customers for losses from a cyber incident. ipNX Protect then makes a two-part promise: Bitdefender works to prevent the attack, and the warranty pays out if something goes wrong anyway. In a market where social engineering drives almost half of payment fraud, the second part is what customers remember.

    What the warranty covers

    Three tiers

    Prevent + Recover

    Protection and warranty, packaged for each ipNX segment.

    Each segment gets a Bitdefender tier and a warranty tier matched to what that customer pays and what they have at risk. The warranty alone, from $0.41 a month, is the entry point for customers who will not pay for a security subscription.

        Support

        Customer Support
        Structure

        All technical product enquiries are handled by Bitdefender's own engineering team, with a clearly defined escalation path in place. To deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for subscribers, we recommend partners take ownership of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support. Full training is included to enable this.

        General Support Rules

        Front-line assistance, including billing and payment-related enquiries, sits with the partner. Anything relating to how Bitdefender products are digitally delivered through the partner is also owned by the partner. Product-level technical matters remain with Bitdefender, with all escalations routed back through the partner.

        eInsurer warranty claims are assessed by eInsurer's claims team. ipNX's front line directs customers to it, and claim status is reported back to ipNX.
